title: The Outsiders #7 DC Comics May 1986 Duke of Oil Mike W Barr Jim Aparo Baxter
conditionDescription: Covers clean and bright with no creases or tears; spine and staples intact. Light handling wear. See photos.
descriptionText:
The Outsiders #7 (May 1986), DC Comics - "Nothing Can Stop the Duke of Oil!" By Mike W. Barr and Jim Aparo, Jim Aparo cover. Baxter paper, $1.50 cover price.

Back cover: The Shadow by Howard Chaykin mini-series ad.

See photos for condition. Ships bagged in a protective mailer.
